metadata.title: fix(tests): fix locators and assertions in admin CRUD regression tests
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary

- Fix broad locators in `test_admin_crud_regression.py` that matched hidden forms or too many elements (strict mode violations)
- Scope server CRUD locators to `#catalog-panel`, `#server-edit-modal`, and `#server-name`
- Use `#team-selector-button` instead of broad `button:has-text("Team")` (matched 6 elements)
- Scope delete confirm button to `[role="dialog"]` (matched 34 elements)
- Check CSS class `active` for tab state instead of nonexistent `aria-selected` attribute
- Get server name from modal input value instead of multiline Actions `<td>`
- Use search box to verify server after create/edit (handles pagination)

## Test plan

- [x] Ran 5 previously failing tests 3 consecutive times: 4 pass, 1 skip (no servers to delete), 0 fail

comments.author: gcgoncalves
comments.body: This selector is a bit broad, and might cause a false positive. A better, more precise option would be `#catalog-panel td:has-text("{server_name}")`

comments.author: gcgoncalves
comments.body: This wait can be replaced with a `search_box.press("Enter")` to apply the search, saving some run time.

comments.author: gcgoncalves
comments.body:
Instead of adding a fixed wait here, replace the `admin_page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded")` above with `admin_page.wait_for_load_state("load", timeout=15_000)`.

Again, the timeout is larger, but `load` fires after all resources (scripts, css, images...) have loaded, giving alpine time to initialise. "domcontentloaded" fires as soon as the HTML is parsed, before the scripts are run.

commits.message:
fix(tests): fix locators and assertions in admin CRUD regression tests

- Use #server-name and #catalog-panel scoped locators for server CRUD
  forms instead of broad input[name="name"] that matched hidden forms
- Use #server-edit-modal for edit flow (modal-based UI, not inline)
- Get original server name from modal input value, not multiline td
- Use search box to find created/edited servers (handles pagination)
- Scope delete confirm to [role="dialog"] to avoid strict mode violation
- Use #team-selector-button instead of broad button:has-text("Team")
- Check CSS class "active" for tab state instead of missing aria-selected
- Add re import for regex class matching

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>

commits.message:
fix(tests): address review feedback and fix broken locators in CRUD regression tests

- Scope td selectors to #catalog-panel to prevent false positives
- Remove unnecessary fixed waits after search fill (oninput filter is synchronous)
- Use wait_for_load_state("load") instead of domcontentloaded + fixed wait
  for Alpine.js initialization after page reloads
- Fix delete test: use #catalog-panel and button[type="submit"]:has-text("Delete")
  instead of nonexistent #serversBody and data-action="delete" selectors
- Fix delete confirmation: use page.on("dialog") for native confirm() dialogs
  instead of looking for nonexistent [role="dialog"] HTML elements
- Fix edit test: scope edit button locator to #catalog-panel, remove
  nonexistent data-action="edit" selector for server buttons
- Remove trailing comment

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(tests): fix delete test - correct column index and count-based verification

- Fix server name extraction: use td.nth(4) for Name column instead of
  td.first which gets the Actions column (multi-line button text)
- Use count-based verification (to_have_count) instead of name-based
  not_to_be_visible to avoid strict mode violations
- Wait for page load after delete (handleToggleSubmit does full navigation)

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
